subject: Quota uplift execution and staged reconciliation plan
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@orbitmetrics.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@orbitmetrics.com
Date: 2026-06-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: temporary quota lift for launch week

Hi Jonas,

Quick one — our product team just moved up the A/B rollout by 48 hours and the traffic spike for the feature is broader than expected. We’re seeing early estimates that our June 22–24 window will exceed our current quota by ~2.5x.

Can Redwood enable an on-demand quota uplift (short-term) for that three-day window and confirm pricing for the uplift + any overrun true-up mechanics? Ideally we’d like a flat uplift cap rather than per-token surcharges so our engineering team can proceed without throttles.

Attached is our usage snapshot through Jun 15. We need a quick turnaround on any commercial terms (credits, prorated billing, approvals) so procurement can accept.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Head of Platform, OrbitMetrics

Attachments: orbitmetrics-usage-jun15.csv (csv, 42KB)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@orbitmetrics.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: temporary quota lift for launch week

Sarah —

Thanks for the heads-up and the snapshot. We can cover the uplift window with a temporary quota increase on Dedicated for June 22–24. High-level proposal:

- Temporary uplift: +250% quota for 72 hours (June 22 00:00 UTC — June 24 23:59 UTC).
- Billing: blended uplift rate (50% of incremental list rate) for the uplifted capacity.
- Overrun true-up: any consumption beyond the uplift cap billed at standard overrun rate, with a one-time prorated credit if usage exceeds uplift by >15% (we’d apply a 20% credit on the incremental overrun line).
- Approval flow: need finance sign-off and a signed MOA addendum. We can fast-track execution if OrbitMetrics signs the attached MOA by EOD Jun 18.

I’m looping Marissa (AM) and Ben (billing) to confirm finance-side timing and whether we can pre-authorize the uplift so you don’t experience throttling.

Next steps (suggested):
1) OrbitMetrics confirms uplift acceptance and signs MOA addendum.
2) Redwood pre-authorizes uplift and marks it for the three-day window.
3) Post-window we reconcile usage and apply any agreed credits.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-17T11:36:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: OrbitMetrics uplift — finance check and credit cadence

Jonas — looping finance and billing. Notes from a quick review:

- We can make the blended uplift rate 45% of incremental list if OrbitMetrics agrees to a short-term addendum and commit to not rolling uplift beyond 72 hours without new approval. That gives them more predictable economics.
- Credit trigger: we prefer a single reconciliation invoice (post-window) rather than continuous retro-charging. Finance will issue one true-up invoice dated Jul 1, with credits applied as a line item.
- Legal: MOA addendum only needs a signature from buyer and our standard uplift clause — low risk.

Ben — please confirm we can pre-authorize the uplift and create a provisional invoice hold so engineering can route without throttles. Laura — FYI for month-end cash flow.

Marissa Cole
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: RE: OrbitMetrics uplift — finance check and credit cadence

All —

We can pre-authorize the uplift and place a provisional invoice hold. Details:
- Pre-authorization: we tag OrbitMetrics account for an emergency uplift window (internal flag) and allow automatic routing to additional capacity for the 72-hr window. No throttling.
- Billing: create provisional invoice for expected uplift capacity (based on usage snapshot) and then reconcile with actuals after the window.
- Credits: approve Marissa’s ask to move to 45% blended uplift rate if buyer signs MOA addendum by 2026-06-18 23:59 PDT. If they sign after that, standard uplift pricing applies.
- Risk control: if actuals exceed uplift by >40%, we escalate to sales leadership to confirm whether to allow extended overrun or cap; we recommend an automated alert at 85% of uplift cap.

I’ll coordinate the provisional invoice and route the MOA to legal for signature-ready copy.

Ben Carter
Pricing & Billing, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: MOA_OrbitMetrics_signed.pdf (will attach once signed)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@orbitmetrics.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@orbitmetrics.com
Date: 2026-06-18T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quota uplift execution and staged reconciliation plan

Hi Jonas —

OrbitMetrics accepts the uplift on the 45% blended uplift rate and I’ve attached the signed MOA addendum. Please proceed with pre-authorization and the no-throttle routing.

One ask from procurement: can you confirm the timing of the post-window invoice and expected date of credit application? We prefer a single reconciliation invoice and credits before our July 5 payroll run.

Thanks — we signed and returned MOA.

Sarah

Attachments: MOA_OrbitMetrics_signed.pdf (pdf, 18KB)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-19T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OrbitMetrics uplift — billing execution

Team —

Confirmed: provisional invoice will be generated on Jun 20 with estimated uplift charges, flagged as provisional. Final reconciliation invoice will be issued Jul 1 with credits applied per the agreed rule (20% credit on incremental overrun if >15% over uplift). Payments due per standard terms; we’ll ensure the credit posts before Jul 5 so OrbitMetrics’ procurement schedule is not impacted.

I’ve created a task for Finance OPS to prioritize the reconciliation posting and set the alert thresholds Ben outlined. Engineering ops has been notified to enable the routing for the Jun 22–24 window.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
